description:
Evan Boyle from the Copilot CLI team shares an advanced tip to improve your code quality before you even open a pull request. Learn how to use the /review command to check for bugs, security issues, and performance problems. Discover how to use multiple models like Gemini, Codex, and Opus simultaneously for a thorough multi-agent code review.

author: GitHub
description:
"An awful lot of enterprises would not function without proper maintenance of open source projects." Anders Hejlsberg discusses the reality that open source is often more "take than give." He highlights the massive investment required to maintain tools like TypeScript and Visual Studio Code, which power the backends of countless companies.
